blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Visayas consumers could face power interruptions on Monday after the grid operator raised another red alert amid persistently thin power supply. In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines said the red alert would be in effect from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. READ: Visayas power woes may persist until 2028, DOE chief warns A yellow alert would also be in effect from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m., and 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. A yellow alert indicates that available power reserves are thinning, meaning any unexpected plant outage could trigger service interruptions.
